text: {"final": {"steps": [{"id": "P1", "file": "eligibility/rules.py", "change": "Add a new function needs_review(household: Household) -> bool. It returns False unless household.status == \"active\" (per R6). For active households, compute score = vulnerability_score(household) (import from eligibility/scoring, per R4) and threshold = threshold_for(household) (existing helper, per R2). Return True exactly when the household does not qualify yet (score < threshold) and is within 5 points of qualifying (threshold - score <= 5, i.e. score >= threshold - 5); return False when score >= threshold since those households already qualify (per R8). Do not hardcode 60; rely on threshold_for so pregnant households use PREGNANCY_QUALIFYING_SCORE (per R1, R2, R3).", "uses": ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R6", "R8"], "after": []}]}}
